description: Browse every command surface — built-in actions, your `.claude/commands/*.md` templates, and plugin-contributed commands. Click the play icon to copy `/'<name>'` to your clipboard.

editor.bodyHint: Use $1..$9 for positional args and $ARGUMENTS for the full string.

editor.globalNotWritable: User-scope commands need the desktop app.

editor.projectNeedsCwd: Project scope needs the active session to have a working directory set.
editor.projectNotWritable: Project commands need a host that can write this repository.
editor.scopeProjectHint: Saved in the active session's working directory.
editor.scopeUserHint: Available across every chat on this machine.
editor.webModeBanner: Read-only preview. Saving needs the desktop app, or a paired host with a workspace open.
editor.webModeBlocked: Saving custom commands needs the desktop app, or a paired host with a workspace open.

emptyCustom: No custom commands found in ~/.claude/commands or .claude/commands.
